metadata.name: Secrets Reveal
metadata.description:
Reveals what the floor is hiding, without touching anything else.
[h1]On the map[/h1] As soon as you arrive on a floor, these are drawn on the minimap with their icons: [list] [*]Secret Room [*]Super Secret Room [*]Ultra Secret Room [*]Any room whose layout contains a Crawlspace [/list] Same idea as the Blue Map: it shows you [i]which wall[/i] to bomb, not the door itself.
[h1]In the room[/h1] A pulsing reticle is drawn over: [list] [*][b]Cyan diamond[/b] - Tinted Rock [*][b]Gold star[/b] - Super Tinted Rock [*][b]Violet arrow[/b] - Crawlspace [/list] Markers vanish the moment a rock breaks, and crawlspaces uncovered mid-fight (Downpour rubble, bombed floors) are picked up automatically.
[h1]Controls[/h1] [list] [*][b]F5[/b] - toggle the whole mod [*][b]F6[/b] - show/hide the bottom-left notices [/list] Both keys are rebindable through Mod Config Menu, which also exposes per-room-type and per-marker toggles, marker size and text size. Mod Config Menu is optional - without it the defaults apply and both keys work.
[h1]Notes[/h1] [list] [*]Lua only, no content overrides. It does [b]not[/b] disable achievements. [*]Turning the mod off does not un-reveal rooms already on the map - the game has no API for hiding a room again. It stops revealing new ones. [*]Crawlspaces created at random from Downpour/Dross rubble rocks cannot be known in advance; those get the in-room marker once they appear. [/list]
[hr][/hr] Source, issues and changelog: https://github.com/ghoulfik/tboi-secrets-reveal
